messages:
maria_cs: FYI — LumoHealth (contact: Emma) just submitted a model onboarding request. They want to onboard a custom finetuned model for triage that will handle PHI. Requirements: private deployment (VPC), strict retention & audit, and latency target p95 < 300ms. Timeline: ~2 weeks. Can we scope next steps?

emma_cust: Thanks! Model name: LumoCare-FT-v1. Format: safetensors (PyTorch). Size: ~13B. Trained on de-identified call transcripts but may still contain residual PHI. Need inference to run inside our VPC and never leave. KMS required for keys. We'll sign NDA if needed.

sandeep_se: @maria_cs got it. A couple quick q's: can they provide both safetensors and a quantized variant (8-bit)? What's expected steady QPS and burst? We'll need the weights to run compatibility and memory checks. Also confirm license (derivative allowed).

joel_ml: Proposed eval plan:
1) compatibility test (load & forward)
2) perf baseline (latency, GPU memory) using 80-token avg seq
3) safety evaluations: PHI extraction prompts, hallucination tests, refusal behavior
I'll set up an eval harness — can they share ~500 anonymized sample prompts and a few expected responses for acceptance criteria?

riley_safety: Tagging @joel_ml @sandeep_se — safety asks: please confirm de-identification process details (who/what/when), data retention must be VPC-only (no logs exported to hosted analytics), KV cache TTL short by default, and add explicit refusal templates for PHI exfil attempts. Recommend a small red-team exercise prior to prod. :warning:

deploy-bot: onboarding-request-created #LB-1872 — assignees sandeep_se, joel_ml, riley_safety

sandeep_se: I'll take infra ownership. Next steps from infra side: compatibility run, quantization check, and private deployment topology with KMS/HSM integration. ETA for infra plan: 3 business days.

emma_cust: We can provide safetensors + checksum and the 500 prompt set (anonymized). QPS initially 2-5, expected peak ~10. KMS required and audit logs must be enabled. NDA is in progress.

maria_cs: OK — action items and owners:
- sandeep_se: infra checks + private deploy plan (ETA 3 business days)
- joel_ml: eval harness + safety tests (ETA 4 business days)
- riley_safety: red-team scope + retention policy review (ETA 5 business days)
I'll set up a 30min sync Thu 10am PT — does that work for owners? :calendar:

joel_ml: Example eval command I'll run (local dev/staging):
```
python eval_harness/run_eval.py --model-path /models/LumoCare-FT-v1.safetensors \\
  --prompts lumo_prompts.json --safety-checks phiextract,refusal --out results.json
```

sandeep_se: Looks good. Adding a canary plan: route 5% traffic to the new model in Dedicated, automatic fallback to a vetted open-compat model if safety triggers or latency regressions. Also confirm whether they need GPU reservation.

riley_safety: If they insist on zero logs outside the VPC we need contractual language and to ensure no telemetry goes to hosted analytics or error-reporting endpoints. I'll draft a short clause and scope the red-team.

maria_cs: Great. I'll reply to Emma with owners, the sync invite, and a checklist for artifacts (model files, checksum, sample prompts, de-id doc). Thanks everyone :heart:

emma_cust: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll upload artifacts to the shared S3 link by EOD tomorrow and accept the calendar invite.
